F4 cross-session recall fixed. Two bugs: (1) _recall_skip missing filler words 'our'/'conversation'/'and'/'can' etc. — 'do you remember our last weather conversation?' gave _recall_q='our weather conversation' (1/3 keyword overlap) pushing the Aug-6 clothing record to rank 7. With expanded skip, _recall_q='weather' (1/1 overlap, ranks top 4). (2) top_k=3->top_k=7 so prior-session records at ranks 4-7 surface in LLM context. 'vest and tshirt can you remember?' now maps to _recall_q='vest tshirt' and directly finds the vest+tshirt record. 8/8 AT test_wo039_f4_cross_session_recall.py + WO-022/037 9/9 still clean. F3 dev-context leak fixed. github_agent.get_status('') returned a human-readable error string ('GITHUB: no repo set...') which tool_router.enrich() injected as [CONTEXT:]. LLM paraphrased it as 'GITHUB_REPO environment variable isn't set...' in the reply. Fix: return '' instead — enrich's if not data guard short-circuits. Real github queries (github status, last commit, open PRs) still route and enrich normally. 6/6 AT test_wo039_f3_github_leak.py. David: no action.

F6 mirror-scrub extended. 'You said X' / 'Your typo' / 'You typed' / 'You wrote' / 'I noticed a typo' openers now stripped by _MIRROR_OPENERS in server.py. Opener-only — mid-sentence 'you said' (e.g. 'Everything you said...') is NOT stripped. Short reply guard (tail < 8 chars) prevents destroying bare 'You said no.' 9/9 AT test_wo039_f6_mirror_scrub.py + WO-036b 10/10 still clean. David: no action.

Real shortcuts (cmd+c, ctrl shift t, escape) still work. 12/12 AT test_wo039_f1_press_parse.py + WO-021 still 9/9. David: no action.

'cancel'/'abort'/'forget it'/'don't'/'stop' still match as substrings. 10/10 AT test_wo039_f2_cancel.py. Exit-gate ordering fixed.
